description: This file defines interfaces, enums, and function prototypes for managing Git submodules within the libgit2 library. It includes declarations for submodule status flags, callback types, update options, and functions for submodule lookup, update, initialization, and configuration.

methods.name: git_submodule_update_init_options
methods.description: Initializes a git_submodule_update_options structure with default values.

methods.name: git_submodule_update
methods.description: Updates a submodule, cloning if missing and checking out to the specified commit.

methods.name: git_submodule_lookup
methods.description: Looks up submodule information by name or path within a repository.

methods.name: git_submodule_free
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a submodule object.

methods.name: git_submodule_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all tracked submodules in a repository.

methods.name: git_submodule_add_setup
methods.description: Prepares a new submodule for checkout, up to the clone step.

methods.name: git_submodule_add_finalize
methods.description: Completes the process of adding a new submodule.

methods.name: git_submodule_add_to_index
methods.description: Adds the current HEAD of a submodule to the superproject's index.

methods.name: git_submodule_owner
methods.description: Returns the repository that contains the submodule.

methods.name: git_submodule_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the submodule.

methods.name: git_submodule_path
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path to the submodule.

methods.name: git_submodule_url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the submodule.

methods.name: git_submodule_resolve_url
methods.description: Resolves a relative submodule URL to an absolute URL.

methods.name: git_submodule_branch
methods.description: Returns the branch associated with the submodule.

methods.name: git_submodule_set_branch
methods.description: Sets the branch for the submodule in the configuration.

methods.name: git_submodule_set_url
methods.description: Sets the URL for the submodule in the configuration.

methods.name: git_submodule_index_id
methods.description: Gets the OID of the submodule in the index.

methods.name: git_submodule_head_id
methods.description: Gets the OID of the submodule in the HEAD tree.

methods.name: git_submodule_wd_id
methods.description: Gets the OID of the submodule in the working directory.

methods.name: git_submodule_ignore
methods.description: Returns the ignore rule for the submodule.

methods.name: git_submodule_set_ignore
methods.description: Sets the ignore rule for the submodule.

methods.name: git_submodule_update_strategy
methods.description: Returns the update strategy for the submodule.

methods.name: git_submodule_set_update
methods.description: Sets the update strategy for the submodule.

methods.name: git_submodule_fetch_recurse_submodules
methods.description: Returns the fetch recurse submodules setting.

methods.name: git_submodule_set_fetch_recurse_submodules
methods.description: Sets the fetch recurse submodules setting.

methods.name: git_submodule_init
methods.description: Copies submodule info into the config, similar to 'git submodule init'.

methods.name: git_submodule_repo_init
methods.description: Prepares a subrepository for a submodule clone.

methods.name: git_submodule_sync
methods.description: Syncs submodule remote info.

methods.name: git_submodule_open
methods.description: Opens the repository for a submodule.

methods.name: git_submodule_reload
methods.description: Reloads cached submodule info from config, index, and HEAD.

methods.name: git_submodule_status
methods.description: Determines the status of a submodule, returning flags.

methods.name: git_submodule_location
methods.description: Gets the location status flags of a submodule.
